The same applies to Iran, they are a signatory to the Nuclear Non-Proliferation treaty. Then they got caught cheating and were sanctioned.

You have to understand the Nuclear Non-Proliferation treaty. Signatories get the sovereign right to nuclear energy, but disavow the bomb. So, they get nuclear knowhow from the countries with it, to build a program of nuclear energy, with safeguards to provide that they won't get the bomb. Violate the safeguards, get sanctioned. This is where Iran and North Korea have gotten the sanctions. If you look at India and Pakistan. They, like Israel, were never signatories, did not get caught cheating, and only got punished for nuclear tests. Likewise, they are not under sanctions. They are also limited from getting nuclear technology and material from signatories of the treaty.

tl;dr The sanctions against North Korea come from violations of the nuclear non-proliferation treaty, Israel was never a part of the treaty. No treaty, no violation of the treaty, no sanctions.
